posts.title: Company Anagrams
posts.description: Company Anagrams Inspiration : My brain is a jumble of parenting, tech news and word games. One day in my boredom I thought about the company name Vercel. It seemed odd, and I wondered where that name came from. Then realized Vercel is an anagram of clever . I can't verify if that was intentionally done by their hired branding agency? But it made me wonder about other companies. Description : To f

posts.title: Mazarine
posts.description: Being amongst Swaths and swaths of antiquity Is the deepest relief I am As ignorant, as nameless, As collective, as individuated, As proximate to slivers of knowledge As anyone here I can sit, anonymous awe, and breathe
